extracted.name: Slow cooker jacket potatoes
extracted.description: This recipe was submitted by a Good Food member and has not been tested by our team.
ingredient_lines: 4 baking potatoes well scrubbed and completely dry
pinch of coarse salt to taste
instruction_lines: Prick the potatoes with a fork several times.
Rub potatoes with olive oil, sprinkle with salt and wrap each tightly in foil.
Place the potatoes into a slow cooker, cover, and cook on High for 4½ to 5 hrs or Low for 7½ to 8 hrs.
